uzo.purpose: Marks one option as yes or no inside a form; it applies when the form is sent: terms accepted, newsletter, remember me.

instead.kialo: A setting that applies at once is a switch, because a checkbox promises nothing until the form is sent; Fundamento covers it with sxaltilo.
One of a few options is a radio group, because checkboxes let a person tick several and the form could not tell which one counts; Fundamento covers it with elekto.

boundary.kialo: A checkbox holds yes or no, because the form sends it or does not; a mixed state belongs to a group of checkboxes.
Several checkboxes stand in a form under a heading the form owns, because the heading names the question and each box one answer; Fundamento has no group Ero yet, so a person decides.
A checkbox without a visible label says that something is ticked, not what, because the box shows the answer and only the label names it.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A checkbox without a form has no sender, because its answer is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may ask for a yes or no before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need it (terms accepted).

with.kialo: Checkboxes stand among the fields of a form, one below the other, because a person reads a form top down and answers it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because ticking a box does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last checkbox.
A check mark inside a dialog applies with the confirmation, because the dialog is the form it belongs to.
The check mark in the box is an ikono check, because the sign for chosen and done is vocabulary of the Ikonaro, drawn by the Aspekto in the size of the box.

never.kialo: A checkbox stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the checkbox could not be reached on its own.

case.de: Die Einstellung soll sofort gelten, nicht erst beim Senden des Formulars.
case.en: The setting is to apply at once, not only when the form is sent.

case.de: Genau eine von wenigen Optionen darf gewählt sein.
case.en: Exactly one of a few options may be chosen.

case.de: Aus einer langen Liste sollen mehrere Werte gewählt werden.
case.en: Several values are to be chosen from a long list.

do.de: Lass die sichtbare Beschriftung sagen, was das Häkchen bedeutet.
do.en: Let the visible label say what the tick means.

do.de: Setze required für eine Zustimmung, ohne die das Formular nicht gesendet wird.
do.en: Set required for a consent without which the form is not sent.

do.de: Stell mehrere Kästchen unter eine Überschrift des Formulars, die die gemeinsame Frage nennt.
do.en: Place several boxes under a heading of the form that names the shared question.

dont.de: Einen dritten, gemischten Zustand erwarten; das Kästchen kennt nur ja oder nein.
dont.en: Expect a third, mixed state; the box knows only yes or no.

dont.de: Die Größe large neu setzen: Sie ist ein veralteter Name für medium und wird als medium gezeigt.
dont.en: Set the size large anew: it is a deprecated name for medium and is shown as medium.

dont.de: Ein Kästchen ohne sichtbare Beschriftung zeigen.
dont.en: Show a box without a visible label.

action.de: Hakt das Kästchen an oder ab; bei readonly oder disabled geschieht nichts, und Enter ändert es nicht.
action.en: Ticks or unticks the box; with readonly or disabled nothing happens, and Enter does not change it.
